groups.problem: The credential-sharing branch returns a raw fetch Response that callers incorrectly consume as parsed token data.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same return-contract mismatch in refreshOAuthTokens. S3 lists additional affected callers, while S7 and S14 focus on its Google Calendar consequence.

groups.problem: Zoho Bigin passes a credential row ID instead of a user ID to refreshOAuthTokens.
groups.rationale: Each reports the same incorrect argument causing calcomUserId to contain a credential ID. S16 points to the helper parameter; the others point to the Bigin call site.

groups.problem: Google Calendar persists the safeParse result wrapper as the credential key instead of its parsed data.
groups.rationale: All five identify the same assignment and database write, with the same resulting credential shape corruption and proposed unwrapping of .data.
